# Epic: Sync and server

**Slug:** sync-and-server
**Status:** draft
**Created:** 2026-10-13

## Goal

Paid end-to-end encrypted sync: protocol and conformance tests, key hierarchy and recovery, Cloudflare server, self-hosting on the user's Cloudflare account, and the signing gate.

## Scope

- Protocol, canonical encoding, test vectors
- Keys, membership log, recovery
- Server on Cloudflare (EU jurisdiction)
- Windows and Apple signing before launch

## Out of Scope

- Attachments, mobile
